name: When is the best time to schedule cabinet installation during a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to schedule cabinet installation during a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to schedule cabinet installation during a home renovation is usually after major structural work, plumbing, and electrical rough-ins are complete, but before flooring, painting, and countertop installation. This sequence protects the new cabinets from potential damage during messy construction phases and allows for accurate measurements for countertops. It ensures a smooth flow to the renovation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule cabinet installation after structural, plumbing, and electrical rough-ins, but before flooring, painting, and countertops.
